answer: Because the ripple weight is recomputed from the comet history each close, the prism audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 8 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 31% of full weight. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
